d.d: The chemical element (symbol Kr) with an atomic number of 36. It is a colourless, odourless noble gas that only reacts with fluorine. It is one of the rarest gases in the Earth's atmosphere.
The one weakness of something or someone that is otherwise invulnerable.
To expose to, or attack with, kryptonite.
To destroy, wreck, or ruin; to affect adversely, as Superman is affected by kryptonite.
